meta.description: Behind every release are people who develop, review, translate and test ProxMenux. This page thanks those contributing today and those who helped the project take its first steps.

header.title: Contributors
header.description: Behind every release are people who develop, review, translate and test ProxMenux. This page thanks those contributing today and those who helped the project take its first steps.

active.heading: Development, review and ongoing collaboration
active.intro: Vaso73, f3rs3n and jcastro contribute regularly through improvements, fixes and reviews. Their work goes beyond testing a release: it also helps build and debug the next ones.

people.Vaso73: Improvements and fixes in OCI manager and ProxMenux Monitor, alongside Slovak translations and language reviews.
people.f3rs3n: Fixes and reviews of script and Monitor behavior, together with ongoing improvements to the Italian translation.
people.jcastro: Development and debugging of OCI, backup and Monitor features, alongside documentation reviews and testing since the project's early days.

code.heading: More contributions to the code
code.intro: The following people have also contributed code changes. Follow their links to explore their work; GitHub's history records contributions and pull requests as they are merged.

community.heading: A community that also tests, translates and documents
community.body: Not all work arrives as code. Reproducing a bug, sharing useful logs, testing different hardware, clarifying an explanation or suggesting an improvement also helps ProxMenux work better.
community.languages: Special thanks to everyone reviewing text in their own language. Translations of the menus, Monitor and documentation bring the project to more people and make it more comfortable to use.

testers.heading: Thank you for the early testing
testers.intro: This recognition still matters. These people helped validate early releases, tested the project on their own equipment, and shared problems and suggestions as ProxMenux began to grow.

contribute.heading: There is a place for your contribution too
contribute.intro: You can help with a small fix, a specific test or a text review. You do not need to develop a whole feature to make a difference.

code.title: Code and review
code.body: Develop features, fix bugs or review a PR. The contributing guide explains how to prepare and propose changes.

testing.title: Testing and diagnosis
testing.body: Try beta releases and share reproduction steps and logs that help others understand a problem.

translations.title: Translations
translations.body: Review messages in your language and help keep them up to date as new features are added.

docs.title: Documentation and design
docs.body: Clarify a guide, add a screenshot or improve the interface so others can follow it more easily.

thanks.title: Thank you for making it possible
thanks.body: To everyone listed here and everyone helping in an issue, a conversation or a test: thank you for spending your time improving ProxMenux.
